sources.title: Office of the President, President Ruto signs into law the Statute Law Bill 2024 (24 April 2024)
sources.said: In a bold step towards environmental protection and conservation, the Bill amends the Public Holidays Act, renaming Utamaduni Day as Mazingira Day to be observed on October 10 every year.

sources.title: Kenyans.co.ke, Government Declares 27th December a Public Holiday (December 2016), quoting the Public Holidays Act and the Gazette
sources.said: "It is notified for the general information of the public that the Cabinet Secretary for Interior and Coordination of National Government, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Public Holidays Act, declares that Tuesday, the 27th December 2016, be a public Holiday." … "The Public Holiday Act, under section 4 provides that when a Public Holiday falls on a Sunday, the first succeeding day (next day), not being a Public Holiday, shall be declared a Public Holiday,” the Public Holiday Act states.

sources.title: The Standard, Government declares Friday a public holiday to mark Idd-ul-Fitr (March 2026), quoting Gazette notice of 18 March 2026
sources.said: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen has declared Friday, March 20, 2026, a public holiday to mark Idd-ul-Fitr. In a Gazette notice dated March 18, Murkomen said the declaration was made in accordance with the Public Holidays Act.

sources.title: The Star, Murkomen declares Wednesday a public holiday (25 May 2026), quoting the Kenya Gazette special issue of 25 May 2026
sources.said: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen has declared Wednesday, May 27, 2026, a public holiday to mark Eid-ul-Adha. The declaration was made through a special issue of the Kenya Gazette dated May 25, 2026.
